questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the complete path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_left at (4, 1), then ramp_right at (3, 2), then ramp_left at (4, 3), then ramp_right at (3, 4), then ramp_right at (4, 5), then crossover at (5, 6), then ramp_right at (6, 7), then ramp_left at (7, 8), then ramp_right at (6, 9), and is caught at the right exit.

questions.question: What is the output pattern after running the machine?
questions.answer: 16 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left. 8 exit left, 8 exit right, 0 are intercepted.

questions.question: How does the crossover enable the alternating pattern?
questions.answer: When a blue ball crosses over to the right side, it triggers the right lever to release a red ball. That red ball crosses back over to the left side, triggering the left lever to release another blue ball, creating the alternating pattern.
